name: Runway
tagline: Professional AI video generation and editing
description: Runway is a pioneering AI video platform used by professional filmmakers and creatives. Its Gen-3 Alpha model generates high-quality video from text and images. Runway also offers AI Magic Tools including background removal, rotoscoping, motion tracking, inpainting, and frame interpolation — all browser-based. It was used in the production of films and award-winning music videos. The platform targets professional post-production workflows.
pricingDetails: Free: 125 credits/month. Standard: $15/month. Pro: $35/month. Unlimited: $95/month. Enterprise: custom.
